parameters.query:
SELECT t.*,
       COUNT(*) OVER() AS total_count,
       ts_rank(
         to_tsvector('simple', COALESCE(t.name_khong_dau, '')),
         websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1)
       ) AS relevance
FROM clickup.tasks t
WHERE to_tsvector('simple', COALESCE(t.name_khong_dau,'')) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple', $1)
   OR t.name_khong_dau ILIKE '%' || $1 || '%'
ORDER BY relevance DESC NULLS LAST, date_updated DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS clickup.sync_targets (
  list_id     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  list_name   TEXT,
  folder_id   TEXT,
  folder_name TEXT,
  added_by    TEXT,
  added_at    TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

SELECT list_name, status, count(*)::int AS cnt
FROM clickup.tasks
GROUP BY list_name, status
ORDER BY list_name, cnt DESC;

SELECT order_task_id, order_task_name, order_task_status, link_type, pvtc_year
FROM clickup.task_links
WHERE student_task_id = $1
ORDER BY link_type, pvtc_year NULLS FIRST;
